title: Aye lal mere asghar , aye lal mere asghar
body:
aye lal mere asghar , aye lal mere asghar
dethi hai sada tum ko yeh kookh jali madar
1. woh alam-e-tanhaayi aur shah ki wo ghurbat
dekhi na gayi tum se baba ki jo thi halath
jhule se gira dala you qud ko paye nusrath
halmin ki sada sunkar
<<DIVIDER>>
2. yeh dekh falak kaanpa tharrayi zami ran ki
pyaase teri gurbat pa sab qalq-e-quda royi
hukmein shahe wala par jab tu ne zuba pheri
sukhe huwe hoton par
<<DIVIDER>>
3. jaatey huwe maidan ko woh lab pe hasi teri
tera woh humakna woh masoom khushi teri
woh sabr tera uss per woh tashna labi teri
rulwayegi ta mehshar
<<DIVIDER>>
4. pyason ke liye beta ek boond nahi paani
jungle hai andhera hai har simt hai veerani
neend aayi tumhe kaise iss dasht mein aya jani
soye ho kaha jakar
<<DIVIDER>>
5. jhula yeh tera qaali aye lal jhulati hoon
behlane ko dil apna lori bhi sunati hoon aur tujhko tasawur mein godi me sulati hoon
yaad aati hai reh reh kar
